description: Core Python programming, data structures, and essential data libraries (Pandas, NumPy) for scripting ETL pipelines and automated database workflows.
Designing Extract, Transform, Load (ETL/ELT) workflows, batch vs. streaming concepts, data cleaning, and orchestration with tools like Apache Airflow.
Star & Snowflake schemas, Fact and Dimension tables, SCDs (Slowly Changing Dimensions), and modern cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).
Big data processing with Apache Spark and PySpark for high-volume data transformations and distributed queries.
Learning Oracle SQL syntax, PL/SQL blocks, cursors, and stored packages to expand beyond MS SQL Server.
Building interactive dashboards, DAX queries, and reports to complement SQL-based MIS reporting.
Execution plans, index strategies, fragmentation, statistics, and query tuning on MS SQL Server.
